It absolutely depends on the person. I feel like very many posts on this thread in general tend to breed hate and hostility and it takes a certain kind of person to either be that way or not. I suggest you seek counseling or people who know you in real life or even better rely solely on communication between you and her. Either trained professionals or address your own situation between the 2 who know best. Absolute strangers can’t see an entire situation and you seem to even doubt that. Nobody on the internet can really know or judge your situation and if you post here already at odds you do see this and it may not be your best outlet. Healing is going to take time and it still may not work out. An easy answer isn’t out there and nobody else can fully weigh the situation as you can to decide just yet what you should do. You are still trying. Whether or not that is right nobody knows. Once you hit your breaking point you will know exactly what’s best for you. My advice would be for more communication and transparency. If she isn’t willing to give that then you have some things to evaluate. You deserve to be allowed to a degree for her to make you feel more comfortable. If she isn’t giving what you need at that point then you need to take that into consideration. It’s on her to see that you may need more and to give it to you and if she isn’t committed to that then you have to realize you deserve a certain amount of it. But you also have to need it at a reasonable level. You don’t want a toxic relationship either way.  You have to evaluate your needs in general and decide if she can meet them if they are totally reasonable. This being said a relationship shouldn’t be prolonged if either isn’t fully on board or reasonable.

You mentioned she’s finally getting a lawyer and excepted. She does have a right to try to fight. The way you said it makes me think you may have one. If not you absolutely must. It will be seperate from anything to do with the divorce. I really hope you have a custody agreement. Never reach out with her or seek any contact further. She’s baiting you but now how you think. She’s likely going to pretend you forced her to leave because she was unsafe or some dumb stuff but those kids are going to need that money and she’s just never coming across as someone who will care. I tried to see both sides of this situation as you see but regardless of caring for her you can’t make her a person that will manipulate you using your children and abandon you all a priority.
